title: Mixed Vegetable Curry
description: A medley of seasonal vegetables simmered in a lightly spiced onion-tomato gravy — a flexible everyday curry that adapts to whatever's in the fridge.
steps: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle, then add the onion and sauté until golden.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute, then add the tomato puree and cook until the oil separates, about 6-8 minutes.
Stir in the turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the carrot, beans, potato and cauliflower, and mix well to coat in the masala.
Add the water, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 15-18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender.
Add the green peas and garam masala, and simmer for another 3-4 minutes. Garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
